name: Thelma Drake
bio: A Representative from Virginia; born in Elyria, Lorain County, Ohio, November 20, 1949; graduated from Elyria High School, Elyria, Ohio, 1967; realtor; business owner; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1996-2004; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Ninth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2005-January 3, 2009); unsuccessful candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Eleventh Congress in 2008.
